# AI Page Ready
> AI Page Ready provides an online tool to score and explain the AI/LLM readiness of web pages for AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Google AI Overviews, helping website owners optimize their content for AI-based discovery and user engagement. :contentReference[oaicite:0]{index=0}

AI Page Ready analyzes pages for discoverability, structured data, content quality, LLM-friendly formatting, accessibility, and LLM as a Judge checks, delivering actionable reports to improve AI SEO performance. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}

- [Login](https://aipageready.com/login): Sign in to view and manage your site analysis reports. :contentReference[oaicite:5]{index=5}
